key_points: Multiple analyst upgrades (BMO, National Bank Financial, TD, Raymond James) to Outperform/Buy.
Enbridge reopened Line 5 after August spill and launched open season for a proposed Texas pipeline.
Completed $2.55 bn acquisition of Tallgrass Energy’s crude oil business, expanding U.S. liquids pipeline footprint.
Raised C$3 bn via a bought‑deal equity offering, strengthening cash position for growth investments.
Short interest fell 47% in August, indicating reduced bearish positioning.
